title: Greek Lemon Potatoes
subtitle: Patates Sto Fourno
description: Slow-roasted until the broth cooks down into a rich lemon-oregano oil and the edges go golden and crisp.

imageCredit.author: Shixart1985
imageCredit.title: Crispy golden potato wedges on a baking tray

ingredients.note: peeled, sliced lengthwise into thick wedges

steps.text: Peel the potatoes and slice them length-wise into thick, robust wedges. Place them directly into a large 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the olive oil, broth, lemon juice, minced garlic, dried oregano, salt and black pepper.
Pour the liquid mixture over the potatoes, tossing them until evenly coated.

Place the pan uncovered into the oven. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, gently flipping the potatoes twice during baking. They are done when the broth evaporates into a rich oil and the potato edges are golden and crisp.

notes: These take the longest of anything in the Greek dinner — start them first and cook everything else around them.
